action.action-desc: Mr. Grijalva introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Natural Resources

form.official-title: To require the Secretary of the Interior to establish a grant program to provide financial assistance to States in eradicating the Asian giant hornet, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Murder Hornet Eradication Act of 2020.

subsection.text: The Secretary of the Interior shall establish a program to provide financial assistance to States for management, research, and public education activities necessary to—

paragraph.text: eradicate the Asian giant hornet; and
restore bee populations damaged by the Asian giant hornet.

subsection.text: A State is eligible to receive funds under this section if such State has demonstrated to the Secretary sufficient need for a program to implement measures to eradicate the Asian giant hornet.

paragraph.text: The Federal share of the costs of the program may not exceed 75 percent of the total costs of the program.
The non-Federal share of the costs of the program may be provided in the form of in-kind contributions of materials or services.

subsection.text: Not more than 5 percent of financial assistance provided by the Secretary under this section may be used for administrative expenses.
For financial assistance under this section, there is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary $4,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2025.

paragraph.text: The term Asian giant hornet means a Vespa mandarinia.
The term Secretary means the Secretary of the Interior.
The term State means each of the several States, the District of Columbia, and the territories and insular possessions of the United States.
